description: MVP benchmark: 3 task classes x 4 architectures x 2 attempts. Real model calls via the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

single_agent.description: One worker with tools, up to 6 steps.

worker_verifier.description: Worker produces a patch; advisory LLM verifier reviews; up to 2 revision rounds.

planner_worker.description: Planner emits a step plan; worker executes it.

parallel_candidates_judge.description: 3 candidate workers; deterministic judge picks the graded-best candidate (no LLM judging).
